The app is verified and ready for you to use. Here's the acceptance summary.

## Your bookmark app — ready for review

**Where to use it:** **http://maker:4000**

Since it's your personal app, the very first screen lets you **create your account** (any email and a password you choose) — that's the one-time setup. After that you're in, and you'll stay signed in on that device. There's no pre-seeded data; you start with the welcoming empty state, exactly as we designed.

**Verification result — all passing.** I checked the built app against every behaviour we approved together, plus internal quality tests:

- **12 end-to-end checks** driving the real app in a browser, one per behaviour family — saving & topic grouping, live search (including the "nothing matched" message), topic buttons with "All" clearing the search, duplicate handling, address tidying, in-place editing, delete-with-confirmation, the required-address rule, the empty state, and sign-in (staying signed in across a reload, sign-out, and rejecting a wrong password).
- **10 internal tests** on the address logic and the storage/account/session layer.

Every one of the 11 approved scenarios is covered and green.

**A note on the behind-the-scenes items** we parked (they don't change the agreed behaviour): passwords are stored hashed; the layout adapts for phone-sized screens; and I've kept notes on stricter security hardening and sync/performance tuning for future attention.

---

Please open it, create your account, and try it out against what we agreed.

- If you find something that **doesn't do what we approved**, tell me — I'll treat it as a fix within this cycle.
- If you think of something **new or different from what we approved**, I'll record it for a later cycle (this trial covers this first cycle).

**Do you accept this software and agree to complete this first cycle?**
